rows.title: Export any report, and large files that don't stall

lines.text: Open a report and choose Export. You get exactly the rows and columns you see, with your filters applied.
lines.title: Export any report to CSV

lines.text: Reports over 10,000 rows now download as they're built, so a big export starts in seconds instead of timing out.
lines.title: Large exports no longer stall

lines.text: Billing webhooks retry on their own, so a slow payment provider no longer loses an event.
Report filters remember the last date range you picked.
Invoices that failed to sync during a provider outage now sync once it's back.
Chart labels are readable in dark mode.
The date picker no longer jumps a month when you open it on the 31st.

rows.need: API tokens made before October 1 stop working on December 15. Make a new one in Settings, then API.

rows.title: Share a report with a link

lines.text: Anyone with the link sees the report as it is now, read only. Turn the link off from the report's Share menu.
lines.title: Share a report with a link

lines.text: Customer names with an apostrophe no longer break search.

rows.title: Faster invoice list on large accounts

lines.text: The invoice list opens in under a second on accounts with thousands of invoices.
lines.title: Faster invoice list on large accounts

lines.text: Tax totals round the same way on the invoice and the summary.
